    19→	// Handle interrupt signals

    21→	signal.Notify(sigChan, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
    22→	go func() {

    24→		cancel()
    25→	}()
    26→
    27→	// Load telemetry preference from settings (ignore errors - default to enabled)
    28→	var telemetryEnabled *bool
    29→	if settings, err := cli.LoadEntireSettings(); err == nil {

    31→	}
    32→
    33→	// Initialize telemetry client and add to context
    34→	telemetryClient := telemetry.NewClient(cli.Version, telemetryEnabled)
    35→	ctx = telemetry.WithClient(ctx, telemetryClient)
    36→	defer telemetryClient.Close()
    37→

    44→		var silent *cli.SilentError
    45→		if !errors.As(err, &silent) {

    47→		}
    48→		cancel()
    49→		os.Exit(1)
    50→	}
